notes: Prototypes 011 and 014: early forest interludes remain Asmodeus-only during Haniel's recovery. After the authored Part Six checkpoint, players may separately run unlimited Cliffside free-time days for Asmodeus (Explore) and Haniel (Patrol), each with three daily actions; no exciting-day story continuation is available until more chapters are written. These optional post-six activities do not alter existing story checkpoints.
